mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility rose 32.3 points from its t-2w trough (-59.9) to -27.6 at t-0w, rebuilding commuting routines; the resulting weekday footfall lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks above its last-28-day mean of -47.1.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -59.9 at t-2w to -27.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is at or below -47.1 while WORKPLACES holds above -30 or keeps rising, which rejects the commuting-footfall mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: Residential time-at-home is decaying (24.0 at t-2w to 13.6 at t-0w), releasing household members into non-essential errands; each sustained drop in RESIDENTIAL toward baseline produces a proportional lift in RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean falls below 15 percent above baseline
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined from 24.0 at t-2w to 13.6 at t-0w
fact:RESIDENTIAL at t-0w is the lowest of the four observed weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is not above -47.1 even though RESIDENTIAL stays below 15 for the next two weekly readings.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has climbed 14.7 points off its t-2w trough (-65.1 to -50.4); once transit use crosses a recovery threshold, discretionary trip-making resumes and RETAIL_REC rises within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean rises more than 10 points above the t-2w trough of -65.1
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -65.1 at t-2w to -50.4 at t-0w
fact:TRANSIT at t-0w equals its t-3w level of -50.4
failure_condition: TRANSIT holds above -55 for two consecutive weeks while RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean stays at or below -47.1.

mechanism_narrative: The joint recovery of WORKPLACES and TRANSIT is the binding constraint: commute and transit trips generate mid-day and post-commute retail footfall, so RETAIL_REC rises only when both series improve together over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT each improve by more than 10 points week-on-week in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES is +32.3 points and TRANSIT is +14.7 points off their t-2w troughs
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is not above -47.1 in any week where WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both improve by more than 10 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-January post-holiday seasonal contraction dominates: RETAIL_REC at t-0w (-45.3) is still 10.9 points below its t-3w level, so the next four weeks remain seasonally weaker than the last four despite the concurrent mobility rebound.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC is -45.3 at t-0w versus -34.4 at t-3w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean exceeds -47.1, rejecting the claim that the post-holiday seasonal drag outweighs the mobility rebound.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has recovered to -13.4 while RETAIL_REC sits 31.9 points lower at -45.3, showing households still confine trips to essentials; while that essentials-versus-discretionary gap stays wide, RETAIL_REC's next four weeks stay below its last four.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM stays within 20 points of baseline while RETAIL_REC stays below -40
evidence_refs: fact:at t-0w GROCERY_PHARM is -13.4 and RETAIL_REC is -45.3, a gap of 31.9 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean rises above -47.1 while the gap between GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC remains wider than 25 points.

mechanism_narrative: The t-2w simultaneous trough across RETAIL_REC, TRANSIT and WORKPLACES marks the peak of movement restrictions; as policy eases after that date, retail capacity reopens and RETAIL_REC's next four weeks exceed the restricted last four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:all six categories reached their four-week extreme at t-2w and partially recovered by t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is at or below -47.1 and both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES fail to improve further over the next two weekly readings.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS rebounded 13.5 points in the last week, signalling reduced fear of public congregation; this sentiment shift precedes a one-week-lagged pickup in discretionary retail visits, so RETAIL_REC improves in the week after a large PARKS jump.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean rises more than 10 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from -38.4 at t-1w to -24.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: In the week following a PARKS rise of more than 10 points, RETAIL_REC does not improve relative to the prior week.
